 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Miami Heat are on the road Wednesday night as they travel to take on the Los Angeles Clippers in an interconference matchup.
 Miami enters Wednesday's game with a 2-5 record after losing on the road to the Los Angeles Lakers Monday night.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Miami Heat forward Giannis Antetokounmpo (7)Gary A. Vasquez-Imagn Images
 In Monday's loss, Giannis Antetokounmpo led the way for the Heat as he recorded 30 points, 12 rebounds and seven assists while Bam Adebayo added 16 points, nine rebounds and four assists of his own.
 The Heat will try to bounce back Wednesday as they face off against a struggling Clippers team on the road.
 Los Angeles enters Wednesday's contest with a 1-6 record after losing at home to the Toronto Raptors Monday night.
 LA Clippers guard Kobe Sanders (4)Darren Yamashita-Imagn Images
 Kobe Sanders led the way for the Clippers in Monday's loss as he ended the game with 26 points, four rebounds and three assists while Isaiah Jackson recorded 19 points and eight rebounds off the bench.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement While both teams are looking to pick up a victory in Wednesday night's matchup, each may be without multiple key players due to injuries.
 Heat Injury Report: Will Giannis Antetokounmpo Play?
 Heat forward Giannis Antetokounmpo (7) Sam Navarro-Imagn Images
 The Heat have two players listed on their injury report for Wednesday, including Antetokounmpo.
 Miami has listed Antetokounmpo as probable and he is expected to play despite dealing with a right wrist sprain.
 The Heat have listed Myron Gardner as questionable due to a right quad contusion and he is in danger of missing Wednesday's matchup.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Clippers Injury Report: Will Rui Hachimura, Brandon Ingram Play?
 Los Angeles Clippers forward Rui Hachimura (28)Kiyoshi Mio-Imagn Images
 The Clippers have four players listed on their injury report, though Rui Hachimura is not one of them.
 Of course, Hachimura missed Monday's game due to left quad soreness but he is off the injury report and will return against the Heat.
 Los Angeles has ruled out Brandon Ingram as he remains sidelined to begin the season while recovering from right heel surgery.
 The Clippers have also ruled out Bradley Beal (right knee injury management), Jordan Miller (left rotator cuff surgery) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (right Lisfranc surgery).
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Los Angeles Clippers forward Brandon Ingram (7)Jayne Kamin-Oncea-Imagn Images
 Fans can catch Wednesday night's matchup between the Heat and Clippers from the Intuit Dome at 10:30 p.m. ET.
